objective: Go/no-go gate: does the V2 rich corpus beat V1's data at a matched 1B-token scratch budget?

comparison_model.description: V1 1B scratch run: same architecture, seed, batch 64x1024, peak LR 6e-4, 2% warmup, cosine to 6e-5

evaluation: scglm_v2.devevaluate on both models: held-out 20% of benchmark TRAIN splits (1000 items per set) and bits/byte on V2 development panels. Official eval splits are not used.
gate: GO if V2 pilot's mean accuracy over the ARC-Easy/PIQA/HellaSwag/WinoGrande proxies is >= V1 1B's; also report bits/byte. NO-GO stops before the main run and is reported to the user.
